labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Must have at least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1 at time of screening.
at least one or more approved second-generation androgen-receptor-pathway inhibitors with or without a prior course of taxane therapy
metastatic histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate

labels.note: mCRPC post-ARPI and docetaxel fits, but bone-only disease with nothing measurable fails the required RECIST measurable lesion for intratumoral therapy.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Prior disease progression on or intolerance to abiraterone.
Prior treatment with any chemotherapy regimen in the mCRPC setting
(either enzalutamide, apalutamide, or darolutamide) is required

labels.note: Chemo-naive mCRPC trial; patient progressed on abiraterone and received docetaxel after castration resistance.
